note: List prices in USD per million tokens (API list-price equivalents). VERIFY on the vendor pricing page before trusting any dollar figure; prices change and differ by plan and model version. Edit this file, not the scanner. Prices are looked up by EXACT model id first; a family substring match is only a fallback and the scanner prints a WARNING listing every model id priced that way. A model set to null (or listed in unpriced_families) is never priced: its tokens are reported with '$ unknown'.
source: Vendor list prices (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5 / 5.5, Haiku 4.5), September 2026. Verify against the vendor pricing page, especially Haiku.
